codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book. The following CPT codes associated with the services outlined in the Billing and Coding Article will not have diagnosis code limitations applied at this time: 36903, 36906 and 36908.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 37182, 37183, 37238, and 37239.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
